versions.changelog:
Initial release of Bike Fit Estimator.

- Calculates frame size, saddle height, setback, stack/reach, crank length, and standover clearance from inseam and height.
- Recommends cockpit position (bar drop and reach) based on rider flexibility and ride type.
- Diagnoses common cycling pain symptoms (e.g., numb hands, knee pain, saddle discomfort) and suggests first-fit adjustments.
- Includes bike fit methodology, verification checklist, and a quick-start guide for command-line usage.
- Stdlib-only, Python 3, fully offline.
